great.text: [comedic, cartoonish, over-the-top proud, like a sports announcer] 三分球！！

miss.text: [comedic, cartoonish, dramatically disappointed] 啊……差一點……

fan.text: [comedic, cartoonish, annoyed] 欸！誰開電風扇啦！

boss.text: [whispering, panicked, comedic] 老闆來了！快裝忙！

caught.text: [stern boss, slow, comedic deadpan] 上班時間……在幹嘛？

win.text: [comedic, cartoonish, triumphant shouting] 我是辦公室投籃王！！讚！

lose.text: [comedic, cartoonish, sulking] 今天手感不好啦……
